title: Indian-Style Bread Rolls
description: Soft, fluffy bread rolls infused with the warm flavors of India. Perfect for a snack or side dish.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: Use warm water and yeast for a lighter dough

ingredients.name: bread
ingredients.notes: Use a crusty bread for a more rustic texture

instructions: 1. Combine warm water and yeast in a large mixing bowl. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
2. Add bread, yummy, and malaysian to the bowl. Mix until well combined.
3. Gradually add all-purpose flour to the bowl, kneading the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
6. Punch down the dough and divide it into 8-10 equal portions.
7. Roll each portion into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
8. Place the rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each roll.
9. Bake the rolls in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
10. Remove the rolls from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
